open_points.subject: OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_ATTRIBUTES
open_points.text: the session cookie's name `OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME` and its attributes `OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_ATTRIBUTES`
open_points.question: Which exact Set-Cookie attributes and values does OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_ATTRIBUTES contain, including Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite, Path, Domain and any lifetime attribute?
options: Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; omit Domain and lifetime
Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; omit Domain and lifetime
Only Secure and HttpOnly, leaving browser defaults for the other attributes
open_points.default_guess: Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; omit Domain, Max-Age and Expires so the cookie is host-only and lasts for the browser session

witness.initial: The owner has no session and opens the sign-in route successfully.
events: The owner submits the right credential and owner_sessions creates a session.
owner_interface sets the session cookie using OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_ATTRIBUTES.
The browser follows a link to an owner route outside the sign-in route's default cookie path.
outcomes: With Path=/, the browser sends the cookie and the owner page opens in the session.
With Path omitted, the browser may apply the sign-in route's default path and omit the cookie on the other route, so Registry shows the sign-in page.
